mechanism: Both drugs inhibit monoamine reuptake and tranylcypromine irreversibly inhibits MAO, creating severe risk of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and unpredictable CNS effects.
action: This combination is contraindicated; duloxetine must not be used within 14 days before or 5 days after tranylcypromine discontinuation due to risk of life-threatening serotonin syndrome and hypertensive emergency.
